name: Global Polynomial Product Trap
description: Replaces the pairwise divisibility condition with a global product of cubic polynomials evaluated on each edge. The polynomial $c_u^3 + c_v^3 - c_u^2 c_v - c_u c_v^2$ factors to $(c_u+c_v)(c_u-c_v)^2$, which is non-zero iff $c_u \neq c_v$. Framing it as a global product $P \neq 0$ forces the model to either mathematically deduce the pairwise inequality and apply graph coloring with degree heuristics, or fall into the trap of writing a naive CSP/backtracking solver that evaluates the product at the leaves (or fails to prune early), which will time out on $N=40$. Furthermore, naive C++ solvers might overflow the product to exactly zero, failing the test case unless they reason about the structure.
